why: The doors sessions asked for, ranked by how often they asked. Every refused ad-hoc command in this repository may proceed only by stating the gap it fills, and the hook appends that sentence to dist/evidence/mcp-gaps.jsonl, so this tree has been recording the list of doors it lacks in its own words. This reads that log. Each row is cross-formulated — what sessions ASK against what the catalogue SERVES, two surfaces that must agree — and each is DEMAND rather than absence, because a repeated ask can mean the asker missed a door that exists. Written by src/scripts/audit-door-demand.ts on every run, EMPTY INCLUDED: an absent file and an empty log are different facts.
